name: IPC APEX EXPO
description: Premier electronics manufacturing trade show. Technical sessions on PCB fabrication, assembly, soldering, reliability. Key networking for EMS/OEM relationships.

name: Electronica
description: World's largest electronics trade fair. 80,000+ visitors, 3,000+ exhibitors. Core event for component sourcing, supplier discovery, and technology trends.

name: Productronica
description: World's leading trade fair for electronics development and manufacturing. Focus on SMT, soldering, coating, test/inspection equipment.

name: PCIM Europe
description: International exhibition for power electronics, intelligent motion, renewable energy, and energy management.

name: SMTconnect
description: System integration in micro electronics. Focus on SMT assembly, interconnection technology, and test.

name: Embedded World
description: World's largest exhibition for embedded systems. Key for automotive, industrial IoT, and edge computing opportunities.

name: NEPCON Japan
description: Japan's largest electronics manufacturing exhibition. 2,000+ exhibitors covering SMT, PCBA, testing, materials.

name: SEMICON West
description: Flagship semiconductor equipment and materials exposition. Intelligence on chip manufacturing, advanced packaging, supply chain.

name: SEMICON Europa
description: European semiconductor industry event. Co-located with Electronica/Productronica in alternating years.

name: Hannover Messe
description: World's largest industrial technology fair. 200,000+ visitors. Key for Industry 4.0, automation, and smart manufacturing intelligence.

name: Automechanika
description: World's leading trade fair for the automotive service industry. Key for automotive electronics and component suppliers.

name: SPS – Smart Production Solutions
description: Europe's leading automation trade fair. Focus on electrical automation, drives, sensors, control, and Industry 4.0.

name: AERODEF Manufacturing
description: Aerospace and defense manufacturing event. Key for ITAR/AS9100-related business intelligence.

name: SIEL Morocco
description: Morocco's international exhibition for electrical, electronics, and renewable energy. Key regional event for North Africa market intelligence.

name: Tunisia Investment Forum
description: Investment forum for Tunisia's manufacturing and offshoring sectors. Key for competitor intelligence and FDI trends.

name: International Defense Exhibition (IDEX)
description: MENA region's largest defense exhibition. Relevant for defense electronics supply chain intelligence.

name: ISA CISS (Israel Subcontracting Show)
description: Israel's key subcontracting show. Critical for Israeli defense/hi-tech supplier ecosystem intelligence.

name: IATF International Automotive Task Force Conference
description: Focused on IATF 16949 quality management. Intelligence on certification trends, audit changes, and OEM requirements.

name: IPC Works Asia
description: IPC's Asian electronics manufacturing event. Standards updates, technical sessions, and supply chain networking.

name: Global Industrie Paris
description: France's largest industrial trade show. Combines former Midest (subcontracting) and Smart Industries events.
